name: 12572-batchdecode-glm45air-dp8
model: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air -- bf16 Mixture-of-Experts, 106B total / ~12B active, public and ungated. ~221 GB of safetensors in 47 shards.
parallelism: tp8 with data-parallel attention at dp8 (dp-size == tp-size) plus a data-parallel vocabulary projection; the 128 routed experts stay tensor-parallel across the same eight ranks, 16 per rank. No expert parallelism, PP=1, no external cache tier. Per-card weights ~37 GB.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 1536 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets and no prefix reuse: exactly 1024 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 output tokens out, no variance on either. ignore_eos true and temperature 0.0, so every request runs a fixed 1024 decode steps.
purpose: A long-form content generation assistant on a 106-billion-parameter expert model, serving 512 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Keys are passed through as launch arguments.

model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air

tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true
enable-dp-lm-head: true

# The engine DIVIDES this by dp-size, so it is the global cap and each rank admits at most 64 --
# exactly the offered load, and the per-rank decode batch the capture ceiling below is sized to.
max-running-requests: 512
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64

disable-radix-cache: true
context-length: 4096

# Weights are ~37 GB per card, leaving ~30 GB of KV pool per rank against ~25 GB of steady-state
# demand. Thin on purpose: under data-parallel attention the KV is not head-sharded, so each rank
# holds the whole KV of its own requests.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
